I knew this game existed for a while now, i came across it before and i fell in love with its colorful and fun artstyle, but unfortunately i never had a music ear, so i didnt get it, because i was too worried i'd just fail over and over.
Now that its in a sale for less price than a literal chocolate bar, i decided to get it just to try it - and oh my goodness gracious this game is genuinely FUN! and i dont suck at it! i am genuinely enjoying every minute! when i fail i have fun repeating the song just for that sweet S!
You mightve come across reviews where people complain about a lot of content being locked behind a DLC, and while that is true, I think the base game offers you enough fun and is still a steal even for full price.
I should probably mention that this game contains overly sexualized girls, especially in the character screen, which seemed like too much for me at some parts and made me slightly uncomfortable, but its not a huge deal

TLDR; get the game, atleast to try it, i think youll be pleasantly surprised :)

Would I recommend muse dash? 100% yes! Muse dash is an all time favorite rhythm game for me, the way the game works feels so polished. All the artworks and colours are very pleasing to the eye, the songs are amazing and its one of those games where you can just zone out and keep playing.

The only thing is, while everything is locked behind muse dash plus I think its a worthy investment, especially whilst its on sale. I think my only complaint is that they got rid of the best dlc that was in the game, aka the miku collab. I don't know the reason as to why they removed it but I hope it comes back one day. There is still a couple of vocaloid songs which is nice I just wish they'd add more.

If you are a fan of simple mechanic rhythm games and/or tohou (there is a BUNCH of content for that) I'd say give it a go. Even if you just buy the base game first to try it out, I think its one of the best rhythm games on the market as of now.

The only reason I probably keep a positive review on this game is because it was cheap and i still play it.

The DLC which has most songs is 5 times the price of the actual game, they haven't added any new songs for people who don't want to pay for it and most artwork for the game is questionable considering all main characters are underage besides like 2 costume characters.

This is almost technically my first rhythm game I've enjoyed and wanted to play seriously. It's very accessible, and I feel like it starts out easy enough for anyone to enjoy. The game first appears very simplistic, I started out playing with just two fingers. I very much enjoyed for the first time being able to play a rhythm game even up to a medium level? I use 4 fingers now to play most songs! I'm enjoying S ranking level 7-8 songs and going crossed eyed on higher levels. Very enjoyable, SURPRISINGLY enjoyable. If you thought you couldn't get into rhythm games, this is the perfect one that I think can catch anyone's interest.

was it necessary to make a loading screen with the text "don't ask how old are the girls" ? ew also the gameplay is not that fun. The art style and music are good. But now I hate it because of that loading screen

Muse Dash is the perfect rhythm game for me! From the art style to the simple rhythm mechanics, everything about this game is addicting! The rhythm buttons are simple, but they really keep you on your toes the higher the difficulty gets! And I will say, the art style is very vibrant and eye candy! I highly recommend this game! 10/10!

Very fun rhythm game with amazing gameplay mechanics. The song selection is one of the best (mostly if you have Muse Plus). Each character having a different skill + the elfins is a great way to make the game fun and helps many players. The charting for the songs is incredibly fun and well made. Although the art direction can be a bit questionable at times, its a good thing that the game lets you hide certain artworks and even use more "SFW" verisons of some playable characters (the cats). The UI is simple and intuitive. Both the in-game and the steam achievements are very fun and really push you to try your hardest at the game. Overall 10/10 rhythm game, one of the best I have ever played.

Whenever I'm bored, without fail, I open Muse Dash. It's extremely fun, there are countless good songs, it updates regularly and some songs are quite challenging (i love a challenge). Although at the time of writing this review steam states i have 60 hours, thats not true because I've played on mobile for quite some time (around 2 years prior).

Although there is many DLCs, MUSEDASH PLUS is genuinly so worth it, as it gives all previous DLCs along with all future ones as a ONE TIME PAYMENT (this really boggles me as most games i've played, have never been this generous).

Their customer support is also great! During my transition from Mobile to PC i actually lost my account and support was able to make me a new account with my previous levels so i didnt have to relevel up (forever grateful).

The only downside imo is the fact that MUSEDASH PLUS does NOT carry over on multiple devices, which means if you purchased it on mobile, sign into that account and continue playing on steam, you'll be required to purchase it again.

Simple yet fun rhythm game. Sucks that most of the songs are stuck behind a paywall but ig that makes sense since the base game is dirt cheap during sales. Default songs are good but wish the songs had a little more variety to them.

It's just not a particularly compelling rhythm game. The mechanics just aren't complex enough to make this a worthwhile game to master. Outside of the rhythm game portion, there's also a gacha aspect to unlock more characters that I found really unappealing, the majority of the game is paywalled behind a DLC that I feel is way too expensive, and there's a lot of gooner material in here that makes it impossible to take the game seriously.

I really Love this game and I want to play it more but since 3rd Dec update, its unplayable, Devs still have not fixed anything after 2 weeks and today they released a 800MB patch BUT this doesn't fix the game, but is just a transfer of some kind to a daughter company... This is Unacceptable. I looked past smaller issues in the past like stutters in song selection or the horrendous sorting menu and common features in rhythm games like a song search function that is void from this game but now I understand, the Devs just don't Love the game or community like they use to and are here for a quick buck or whatever, very saddening...

And seeing people still give a positive review for this game as of now, Like have they updated the game since 3rd of Dec or are they just the 1 in a million that didn't get effected by the long list of bugs like input delays or just purple screens.

Anyway Devs please fix this game, I usually don't write reviews but this is just embarrassing on your part and frustrating for your community. Don't make me lose the last bit of hope I have in you to fix this game.
